relationships.relation_statement: For every ambient n>=2, set k=1 and multidegree [2n-3]. The expected Fano dimension is 2(n-1)-((2n-3)+1)=0, so the generic line problem is the one-hypersurface subfamily of finite complete-intersection Fano problems.
relationships.evidence_location: Introduction: Fano-problem dimension condition; direct substitution k=1 and degree 2n-3.
relationships.inheritance_policy: No automatic inheritance. A result may be transferred only after explicitly checking its hypotheses, parameter specialization, solution convention and genericity.
relationships.caveats: Special hypersurfaces may have positive-dimensional Fano schemes; the family link concerns the generic finite locus.

relationships.relation_statement: Set ambient projective dimension n=3, linear-space dimension k=1, and multidegree [3]. The complete intersection is one hypersurface, and its Fano scheme parameterizes precisely the lines in this problem.
relationships.evidence_location: Definition of a Fano problem in the introduction; hypersurfaces are the one-entry multidegree case.
relationships.inheritance_policy: No automatic inheritance. A result may be transferred only after explicitly checking its hypotheses, parameter specialization, solution convention and genericity.
relationships.caveats: The cubic-surface case is the exceptional Weyl-group case, not a full-symmetric case. Use only general hypersurfaces with finite reduced line schemes.
